name: Spiral Weapon Wheel
author: Henning Berge
description: A weapon wheel in the style of Prey (2017)'s favourites wheel: hold Triangle and the game slows down for a moment, then holds (Going Commando's own pause, run from its copied code), while everything you can put on the quick select (the Quick Select page's weapons and gadgets) lies on a spiral that the stick turns through, loop after loop, twelve to a loop. Each item's glyph is made as the game runs from your own game's icon, on a cell of its colour; the one in hand and the ones on your quick select are marked (with their quick select number); the health meter hides while it is open; its name and ammo show in the middle; let go of Triangle to equip it. A double tap is the quick swap. Ratchet & Clank's own icons, names and font. Settings: size, start angle, direction, the spiral's depth, hold or toggle, the hold before the pause, the slow-down and the ease back. Needs OpenRAC with mod interface 1.40 (pictures in a mod's overlay) and the hook points rac1.level.update_play, rac1.freeze.update and rac1.freeze.draw (not in a release yet). Wheel art and spiral design from Prey Menu by KerosenileArsonist.

settings.name: Pause while open
settings.description: On: the world holds while the wheel is open (Going Commando's pause, after the slow-down). Off: the wheel opens over the running game, from Ratchet & Clank's own Triangle.

settings.name: Slow-down before pausing
settings.description: As the wheel opens the game's time eases down to an eighth of its speed, then the pause holds it, as Prey's wheel does. Short: about 0.15 s of game time; Prey-like: about 0.3 s; Off: the pause at once.

settings.name: Ease back on close
settings.description: On: as the wheel closes, the game's time eases back up the way it slowed down (an eighth of its speed to full). Off: it goes on at full speed at once.

settings.name: Open and close
settings.description: Hold: let go of Triangle to equip. Toggle: the wheel stays up when Triangle is let go; press Triangle again to equip. Circle closes it with nothing picked, either way.

settings.name: Hold before pausing
settings.description: How long Triangle is held before the wheel opens. Going Commando: its own 4 frames; a natural tap is often that long. A little longer (the default): 8 frames, so taps and double taps usually do not open it. Longer: 12 frames. On PAL each is scaled to its 50 ticks a second (3, 7, 10).

settings.name: Size
settings.description: The wheel's size: 1 is two thirds of the screen's height (Prey Menu's).

settings.name: Start angle
settings.description: Where the spiral starts, in degrees counter-clockwise from 3 o'clock: 90 is 12 o'clock, 0 is 3 o'clock, -90 is 6 o'clock. The first loop's first slot is there; your quick select's items sit at their own directions on that loop.

settings.name: Clockwise
settings.description: Off: the spiral turns counter-clockwise (Prey Menu's default). On: clockwise.

settings.name: Spiral depth
settings.description: Prey Menu's fDepth: each slot behind the pointer is drawn 0.9 + 0.0666 * depth times as large as the one after it. A lower value spreads the loops further apart; a higher one keeps them closer.

settings.name: Click sound
settings.description: A sound as the pointer moves to another item. Ratchet & Clank's quick select is silent and has no UI click: on, it plays a stand-in (the sound a help message opens with).
